Plewr, "3D Rigged Character Model"

Downloaded file: characterRIGGED.glb

Retrieved: 2026-07-26

The model is used only as a development-time rig and base mesh for the
pre-rendered South Gate exploration sprite atlas. Blender and the source model
are not part of the game runtime.
